cast.design: A big, deep-voiced Nigerian man in his mid-forties from Lagos, resonant and commanding, with a Lagos Nigerian English accent.
cast.style: Brisk orders, coaching a new hand; a short burst of approval when it is earned.
cast.sample: So you're Blue watch's new hand in my party. Everyone aboard fights fires before they do anything else. I'm lighting a drill fire in the gym. The red cabinets in the passages hold extinguishers. Take one, find the fire, put it out. Go.
